_help: Scope of evidence-retention.py. Globs are relative to the evidence root and `*` crosses folders. A round folder goes whole when its newest file passes the cutoff; a record file directly in its top folder goes on its own, one deeper goes with its folder; keep wins over both and must name every file a tool reads at run time. Leave out any folder that holds the only copy of something (specs of unshipped work, design drafts). apk_rule is the Android release rule (vc<N> in build names, .aab bundles mark releases); set it false for any other stack. trash_days 30: removed files wait 30 days in <root>-trash.
